answer: Each challenge carries a 32 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. Because the derivation is bound to the jetty signature, the spiral gate rejects a mismatch, and the wander checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. A bank of pre-written answers as a result has nothing to key against, and filling 180 aliases means authoring 180 texts that each match their own nonce. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
